verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that exposes its own tools to external AI assistants (docs-10, docs-11, docs-55, probe-4), but this is the opposite direction from the story: there is no evidence that Hightouch's own built-in agent or platform can act as an MCP client and plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. Since Hightouch markets itself as an 'Agentic Marketing Platform' with a built-in agent, the axis is a fair question, but no evidence shows this client-side capability.
